topic: Earth's tilted axis and day length
key_concepts: Earth rotates on its axis, causing day and night
One complete rotation takes about 24 hours
Only half of Earth is illuminated by the Sun at any time
Earth's axis is tilted at about 23.5 degrees
In June, the Northern Hemisphere tilts toward the Sun
Direct solar rays produce warmer temperatures
Six months later, the Southern Hemisphere tilts toward the Sun
Daytime length varies throughout the year
In Manila, the longest daytime occurs around June and the shortest around December
Daytime length increases from December to June and decreases from June to December
The hemisphere tilted toward the Sun has longer daytime
Earth's revolution changes which hemisphere is tilted toward the Sun
